name: ETL ClickPost To MySQL
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select ClickPost as the data source.
2.  Select your added MySQL data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your ClickPost Account using the **\+** icon with your **API Key.**
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/clickpost/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
